Dear Sir:
Subject: Proj. I 94-5(45)317; I.D. 1030-1-00 Proj. E 078-1(47); I.D. 2015-1-00 Airport Spur
I-94 to General Mitchell Field Milwaukee County
This is in response to a communication from Mr. H. L. Fiedler, State Highway Engineer, dated June 19, 1973, addressed to the Milwaukee County Park Commission.
The request was for review and comments on the submitted Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the proposed subject highway project. The document was submitted to the Park Commission staff for its report which was presented to the Milwaukee County Park Commission at its July 19, 1973 meeting.
The Park Commission unanimously approved the staff's report which states as follows:
"The Draft Environmental Statement for the Airport Spur has been reviewed by the Park Commission staff, and it has determined that the recommended alternate Corridor location (#5) for the Airport Spur does not conflict with existing or proposed Milwaukee County parks.
"Either of the alternate Corridors #2 and #4, if implemented, would come close to existing park lands known as Holler Park.
